settings.doc: Top-level keys of the scene file that are plain render settings. Any string "$name" anywhere in the file is replaced by the value of "variables"[name]. Colours are [r, g, b] or one of the names black, white, red, green, blue. Integers may be written as whole floats.

fields.name: width
fields.doc: Image width in pixels (--width overrides).

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Image height in pixels (--height overrides).

fields.name: supersamples
fields.doc: Samples per pixel at least; rounded up to a multiple of samples_per_chunk squared.

fields.name: samples_per_chunk
fields.doc: Each pass over the image takes this squared samples per pixel.

fields.name: chunk_size
fields.doc: Side in pixels of the squares the image is rendered in.

fields.name: max_depth
fields.doc: Longest path, in bounces, before it is cut off.

fields.name: shadow_bias
fields.doc: Distance scattered and shadow rays start off the surface, in scene units.

fields.name: black_threshold
fields.doc: Paths whose throughput falls to this or below are dropped.

fields.name: path_termination
fields.doc: What ends a path: black at max_depth only, or Russian roulette as well.

fields.name: russian_roulette_depth
fields.doc: With russian_roulette: bounces before roulette starts.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Render seed: the same seed gives the same image (--seed overrides).

fields.name: sample_lights
fields.doc: Sample lights directly (next event estimation) rather than only by chance hits.

fields.name: filter
fields.doc: Pixel reconstruction filter.

fields.name: background
fields.doc: Seen where rays hit nothing: a colour, or {"type": "gradient", "bottom": colour (default white), "top": colour (default [0.5, 0.7, 1])}.

camera.doc: The camera (required): a thin-lens perspective camera focused at the distance of lookat.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of the camera.

fields.name: lookat
fields.doc: Point looked at; its distance is the focus distance.

fields.name: up
fields.doc: Up direction, usually [0, 1, 0].

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Field of view in radians: the image's height spans tan(angle) at unit distance.

fields.name: aperture
fields.doc: Lens radius in scene units, for depth of field; 0 for a pinhole.

sun.doc: The directional sun light, sampled directly; absent or null for none. With a skysphere in objects it follows the sky's sun_direction and is reddened by its atmosphere.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Direction towards the sun; required without a skysphere, not allowed with one.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour of the light.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Irradiance on a surface facing the sun (above the atmosphere, with a skysphere).

fields.name: angular_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the sun's disc, degrees.

output.doc: How linear pixel values are mapped for display in a PNG (EXR output ignores all but glare).

fields.name: exposure
fields.doc: Multiplier on linear values before tone mapping.

fields.name: tonemap
fields.doc: Tone map: none clips above 1, reinhard is v / (1 + v).

fields.name: transfer
fields.doc: Display encoding.

fields.name: gamma
fields.doc: With transfer gamma: the exponent.

fields.name: glare
fields.doc: Camera glare (bloom) around bright pixels: true for defaults, or this object; absent or false: none.

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: Fraction of light spread into the glare.

fields.name: core
fields.doc: Angular size of the glare's core, degrees.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Angle the glare reaches, degrees.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Only pixels brighter than this (after exposure) glare.

light.doc: One entry of "lights": a point light.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Position of the light.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Colour of the light (or a name: white, red, ...).

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: Brightness; falls off with the square of distance.

air.doc: Accepted but ignored: parse_air always returns a vacuum whatever the value. Use a "fog" or "volume" object instead.

object_common.doc: Keys handled generically for objects. "material", "medium" and "normal" apply to geometry-backed objects, checkeredplane, planet, the rock objects, and (replacing their own shading, only if material or medium is given) ocean and grass; skysphere, box_terrain, landscape, firework, fog, volume, mountains and the cloud types ignore them. "transform", "inverse" and "clipped_by" apply to geometry-backed objects only. Applied in the order clipped_by, inverse, transform.

fields.name: material
fields.doc: Name of the surface's material; absent (and no medium): white lambertian. On a shape nested in a CSG or transform, makes that part keep its own material.

fields.name: medium
fields.doc: Name of a medium (a material that varies over the surface); takes precedence over material.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: Bump mapping: tilts the shading normal by a pattern, without changing the shape. Applies wherever material/medium do. Clashes with plane's own "normal".

fields.name: pattern
fields.doc: The pattern of bumps.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: How strongly the normal is tilted.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Size of the pattern: a number, or [x, y, z] to stretch it; never zero.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: wrinkles: layers of finer detail.

fields.name: frequency
fields.doc: ripples and waves: rings per unit of the pattern.

fields.name: phase
fields.doc: ripples and waves: shift of the rings, in cycles.

fields.name: transform
fields.doc: List of transform steps (see transform_step), applied in order to the whole shape including its clipping, eg. [{"scale": 2}, {"rotate": [0, 45, 0]}, {"translate": [0, 1, 0]}]. Geometry-backed objects only (sphere, triangle, mesh, smoothmesh, box, plane, rotate, transform, CSG, terrain, the POV-Ray shapes), at top level or nested; ignored by checkeredplane and by procedural objects.

fields.name: inverse
fields.doc: Turn the shape inside out (its outside becomes its inside, for CSG). Geometry-backed objects only (sphere, triangle, mesh, smoothmesh, box, plane, rotate, transform, CSG, terrain, the POV-Ray shapes), at top level or nested; ignored by checkeredplane and by procedural objects.

fields.name: clipped_by
fields.doc: Keep only the part of the surface inside this shape (does not close the cut). Geometry-backed objects only (sphere, triangle, mesh, smoothmesh, box, plane, rotate, transform, CSG, terrain, the POV-Ray shapes), at top level or nested; ignored by checkeredplane and by procedural objects.

transform_step.doc: One step of a "transform" list (or of a transform object's "steps"): an object with exactly one of these keys. Steps apply in list order.

fields.name: translate
fields.doc: Move by [x, y, z].

fields.name: rotate
fields.doc: [x, y, z] degrees about the x axis, then y, then z (right-hand rule); or {"roll", "pitch", "yaw"} naming the same angles.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: A number, or [x, y, z] factors, about the origin.

fields.name: axis_rotate
fields.doc: Rotate about any axis through the origin.

fields.name: axis
fields.doc: The axis; must not be zero.

fields.name: angle
fields.doc: Degrees, right-hand rule.

fields.name: matrix
fields.doc: 12 numbers in POV-Ray's order: the three rows of the linear part, then the translation.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Centre.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: v0
fields.doc: First vertex.

fields.name: v1
fields.doc: Second vertex.

fields.name: v2
fields.doc: Third vertex.

box.label: Box
box.doc: An axis-aligned box between two corners.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: The opposite corner (either order).

plane.label: Plane
plane.doc: An infinite horizontal ground plane at height y; or, with normal and distance, POV-Ray's plane (the half-space n.p < distance, usable in CSG).

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Height of the horizontal plane (the form used when "normal" is absent).

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: Half-space form: the plane's outward normal. Only works on a plane nested in a CSG or transform without its own material (see notes).

fields.name: distance
fields.doc: Half-space form: distance of the plane from the origin along the normal.

checkeredplane.label: Checkered plane
checkeredplane.doc: A horizontal plane at height y with the object's material or medium (use a checkered-y-plane medium for the checks).

fields.name: y
fields.doc: Height of the plane.

cylinder.label: Cylinder
cylinder.doc: A cylinder between two end points, closed by flat ends unless open.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Centre of one end.

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: Centre of the other end; must differ from base.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the flat ends off.

cone.label: Cone
cone.doc: A truncated cone between two end points with a radius at each.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Centre of the base end.

fields.name: base_radius
fields.doc: Radius at the base.

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: Centre of the cap end; must differ from base.

fields.name: cap_radius
fields.doc: Radius at the cap (0 for a point).

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the flat ends off.

disc.label: Disc
disc.doc: A flat circular disc with an optional central hole.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre of the disc.

fields.name: normal
fields.doc: Direction the disc faces (non-zero); clashes with the common bump-map "normal", so the disc must sit inside a transform or CSG item without its own material.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Outer radius.

fields.name: hole_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the hole; must be at least 0 and less than radius.

torus.label: Torus
torus.doc: A torus about the y axis, centred on the origin.

fields.name: major
fields.doc: Radius of the ring's centre line; must be positive.

fields.name: minor
fields.doc: Radius of the tube; must be positive.

quadric.label: Quadric
quadric.doc: The surface A x^2 + B y^2 + C z^2 + D xy + E xz + F yz + G x + H y + I z + J = 0, solid where negative.

fields.name: squares
fields.doc: Coefficients [A, B, C] of x^2, y^2, z^2.

fields.name: mixed
fields.doc: Coefficients [D, E, F] of xy, xz, yz.

fields.name: linear
fields.doc: Coefficients [G, H, I] of x, y, z.

fields.name: constant
fields.doc: Constant term J.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

poly.label: Polynomial surface
poly.doc: The zero surface of a polynomial in x, y and z of any order, solid where negative.

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Degree of the polynomial; needed (at least 1) when "coefficients" is used, ignored with "terms".

fields.name: coefficients
fields.doc: All coefficients of the polynomial in POV-Ray's order (x^2, xy, xz, x, y^2, yz, y, z^2, z, 1 for order 2; 20 for order 3, 35 for order 4); required unless "terms" is given.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Alternative to "coefficients": list of [c, i, j, k] for the terms c x^i y^j z^k (whole-number powers); takes precedence.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

cubic.label: Cubic surface
cubic.doc: The zero surface of an order-3 polynomial in x, y and z, solid where negative.

fields.name: coefficients
fields.doc: All coefficients of the polynomial in POV-Ray's order (x^2, xy, xz, x, y^2, yz, y, z^2, z, 1 for order 2; 20 for order 3, 35 for order 4); required unless "terms" is given.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Alternative to "coefficients": list of [c, i, j, k] for the terms c x^i y^j z^k (whole-number powers); takes precedence.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

quartic.label: Quartic surface
quartic.doc: The zero surface of an order-4 polynomial in x, y and z, solid where negative.

fields.name: coefficients
fields.doc: All coefficients of the polynomial in POV-Ray's order (x^2, xy, xz, x, y^2, yz, y, z^2, z, 1 for order 2; 20 for order 3, 35 for order 4); required unless "terms" is given.

fields.name: terms
fields.doc: Alternative to "coefficients": list of [c, i, j, k] for the terms c x^i y^j z^k (whole-number powers); takes precedence.

fields.name: bounds
fields.doc: Optional box the (possibly unbounded) surface is clipped to; absent means unclipped.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner of the box.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner of the box.

polygon.label: Polygon
polygon.doc: A flat polygon through coplanar 3D points, with holes where one loop lies inside another.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: At least three coplanar [x, y, z] points; a loop closes when its first point repeats, and further loops are holes.

prism.label: Prism
prism.doc: A 2D outline in the xz plane swept along y between two heights.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Outline as [x, z] points; a loop closes when its first point repeats, loops inside others are holes.

fields.name: height1
fields.doc: y of one end.

fields.name: height2
fields.doc: y of the other end; must differ from height1.

fields.name: spline
fields.doc: How the points join; "bezier" takes four points per segment.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Straight pieces each bezier segment is flattened into (bezier only; 0 fails).

fields.name: sweep
fields.doc: "conic" scales the outline by its height towards an apex at y = 0, which the heights must not straddle.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the end faces off.

lathe.label: Lathe
lathe.doc: A 2D profile spun about the y axis.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Profile as [radius, y] points: at least 2 for linear, 4 for cubic, a multiple of 4 for bezier.

fields.name: spline
fields.doc: "cubic" is a Catmull-Rom curve through all but the first and last points; "bezier" takes four points per segment.

sor.label: Surface of revolution
sor.doc: A profile spun about y whose squared radius is a cubic in y through all but the first and last points.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: At least four [radius, y] points with strictly increasing y.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave the flat end caps off.

sphere_sweep.label: Sphere sweep
sphere_sweep.doc: The volume swept by a sphere moving, and changing radius, along a path.

fields.name: spheres
fields.doc: List of [x, y, z, radius]: at least 2 for linear, 4 for the curved splines.

fields.name: spline
fields.doc: "cubic" passes through all but the first and last spheres; "b_spline" passes near them.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Straight pieces per curved segment (not used by linear).

blob.label: Blob
blob.doc: Soft components whose fields add up, with the surface where the total reaches the threshold.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Field value of the surface; must be positive.

fields.name: components
fields.doc: The field sources; each adds strength x (1 - d^2/r^2)^2 within its radius.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Shape of the component.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre (sphere components only, where it is required).

fields.name: base
fields.doc: One end of the axis (cylinder components only, where it is required).

fields.name: cap
fields.doc: Other end of the axis (cylinder components only, where it is required).

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Reach of the component's field; must be positive.

fields.name: strength
fields.doc: Field at the centre; negative carves away.

isosurface.label: Isosurface
isosurface.doc: The surface where a function of x, y and z equals a threshold, solid where it is less, inside a container.

fields.name: function
fields.doc: f(x, y, z). Text expression: numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh sqrt abs exp ln log floor ceil sqr pow min max mod noise3d select.

fields.name: threshold
fields.doc: Value of the function at the surface.

fields.name: contained_by
fields.doc: Container: {"box": {"min", "max"}} or {"sphere": {"center", "radius"}} (sphere wins if both); default the box from [-1, -1, -1] to [1, 1, 1].

fields.name: box
fields.doc: A box container.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: One corner.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite corner.

fields.name: sphere
fields.doc: A sphere container.

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius.

fields.name: max_gradient
fields.doc: Upper bound on the function's slope; too low leaves holes, too high is slow; must be positive.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.doc: Distance tolerance of the root search; must be positive.

fields.name: open
fields.doc: Leave off the container's surface where it cuts the solid.

superellipsoid.label: Superellipsoid
superellipsoid.doc: (|x|^(2/e) + |y|^(2/e))^(e/n) + |z|^(2/n) = 1, a rounded box within the cube from -1 to 1.

fields.name: e
fields.doc: East-west exponent: 1 is round, near 0 square; must be positive.

fields.name: n
fields.doc: North-south exponent: 1 is round, near 0 square; must be positive.

julia_fractal.label: Julia fractal
julia_fractal.doc: A 3D slice of the quaternion Julia set of q^2 + c.

fields.name: c
fields.doc: The quaternion constant as four numbers [a, b, c, d].

fields.name: slice
fields.doc: Fourth component of every point of the 3D slice.

fields.name: max_iteration
fields.doc: Iterations before a point counts as inside; must be positive.

fields.name: accuracy
fields.doc: Distance tolerance of the surface search; must be positive.

text.label: Text
text.doc: Extruded letters from a font, about one unit high on the baseline y = 0 from x = 0, from z = 0 back to z = thickness.

fields.name: font
fields.doc: TrueType or OpenType font file (.ttf or .otf).

fields.name: string
fields.doc: The text; must have at least one visible glyph.

fields.name: thickness
fields.doc: Depth of the letters along z; must be positive.

fields.name: offset
fields.doc: Extra [x, y] shift added after each character, beyond its advance width.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Edges each glyph curve is flattened into.

mesh.label: Mesh
mesh.doc: A triangle mesh from an OBJ file, flat shaded; each file and scale is loaded once and shared.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: OBJ file, relative to where the renderer runs.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: [x, y, z] factors applied to the vertices.

smoothmesh.label: Smooth mesh
smoothmesh.doc: A triangle mesh from an OBJ file, shaded with interpolated vertex normals.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: OBJ file, relative to where the renderer runs.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: [x, y, z] factors applied to the vertices.

height_field.label: Height field
height_field.doc: A triangulated surface over the unit square in x and z, with heights from an image's brightness or a function.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: Image whose brightness gives heights 0 to 1 (top row at z = 1); takes precedence; one of src or function is required.

fields.name: function
fields.doc: Height as f(x, z) over 0 to 1, used when there is no src. Text expression: numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh sqrt abs exp ln log floor ceil sqr pow min max mod noise3d select.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: [cells in x, cells in z] sampled from the function (not used with src).

fields.name: smooth
fields.doc: Interpolate normals from the slope instead of flat facets.

fields.name: water_level
fields.doc: Triangles entirely below this height are left out.

parametric.label: Parametric surface
parametric.doc: The surface (x(u, v), y(u, v), z(u, v)), triangulated on a grid with smooth normals.

fields.name: x
fields.doc: x as a function of u and v. Text expression: numbers, + - * / ^, parentheses, pi, e, and sin cos tan asin acos atan atan2 sinh cosh tanh sqrt abs exp ln log floor ceil sqr pow min max mod noise3d select.

fields.name: y
fields.doc: y as a function of u and v (same syntax as x).

fields.name: z
fields.doc: z as a function of u and v (same syntax as x).

fields.name: u
fields.doc: Range [u0, u1] of u.

fields.name: v
fields.doc: Range [v0, v1] of v.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: [cells in u, cells in v] of the grid; each at least 1.

bicubic_patch.label: Bicubic patch
bicubic_patch.doc: A Bezier patch from a 4 by 4 grid of control points, triangulated with smooth normals.

fields.name: points
fields.doc: Exactly 16 [x, y, z] control points, four rows of four.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Cells each way the patch is divided into; at least 1.

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.doc: Another shape, rotated about the origin by Euler angles.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The shape to rotate.

fields.name: roll
fields.doc: Degrees about the x axis.

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: Degrees about the y axis.

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: Degrees about the z axis.

transform.label: Transform
transform.doc: Another shape scaled, rotated and moved; with a named geometry as item, an instance of it.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The shape to transform.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: A number, or [x, y, z] factors; applied first.

fields.name: rotate
fields.doc: Euler angles, applied after scale.

fields.name: roll
fields.doc: Degrees about the x axis.

fields.name: pitch
fields.doc: Degrees about the y axis.

fields.name: yaw
fields.doc: Degrees about the z axis.

fields.name: translate
fields.doc: Movement, applied last.

fields.name: steps
fields.doc: Instead of scale, rotate and translate (not both): a list of transform steps applied in order (see transform_step).

union.label: Union
union.doc: CSG union: everything inside any of its shapes, inner surfaces kept.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The shapes combined; at least one. An item with its own material or medium keeps it.

merge.label: Merge
merge.doc: CSG merge: a union with the surfaces inside other items removed (for transparent materials).

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The shapes combined; at least one. An item with its own material or medium keeps it.

intersection.label: Intersection
intersection.doc: CSG intersection: what is inside all of its shapes.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The shapes combined; at least one. An item with its own material or medium keeps it.

difference.label: Difference
difference.doc: CSG difference: the first shape with the others cut away.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: The first shape less all the others; required unless "a" is given.

fields.name: a
fields.doc: Alternative to items: the shape cut from.

fields.name: b
fields.doc: Alternative to items: the shape cut away (required with a).

box_terrain.label: Box terrain
box_terrain.doc: A fixed-size blocky landscape of boxes with noise heights and its own materials.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the heights.

terrain.label: Heightmap terrain
terrain.doc: Ground whose height comes from a heightmap: flat, fractal noise or an image.

fields.name: heightmap
fields.doc: The heights: see its fields. Absent: a flat 20 x 20 square at y = 0.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: Where heights come from.

fields.name: min
fields.doc: [x, z] corner of the area covered.

fields.name: max
fields.doc: Opposite [x, z] corner.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Grid cells along the longest side (ignored if cell_size is given).

fields.name: cell_size
fields.doc: Size of a grid cell, in scene units; default is the longest side / resolution.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Height (y) of the ground's base level.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Noise type: shifts the noise pattern.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.doc: Noise type: height of the relief either side of base.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Noise type: horizontal size of the largest features.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: Noise type: layers of finer detail.

fields.name: persistence
fields.doc: Noise type: amplitude of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: lacunarity
fields.doc: Noise type: frequency of each octave relative to the last.

fields.name: ridged
fields.doc: Noise type: ridged noise, for sharp crests.

fields.name: src
fields.doc: Image type (required there): greyscale image file of heights.

fields.name: height
fields.doc: Image type: height of a white pixel above base.

landscape.label: Landscape (simulated)
landscape.doc: Terrain grown by simulating tectonic uplift, river and glacial erosion, volcanoes and sediment on a patch of a planet (or the whole planet), with its own materials.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the planet.

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Years of landscape evolution to simulate; 0 shows the initial noise topography.

fields.name: domain
fields.doc: What is simulated; absent: a 128-cell patch at the most mountainous place.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: A patch of the planet, or the whole sphere.

fields.name: cells
fields.doc: Patch: cells along a side; planet: resolution of the sphere's grid (default 64 there).

fields.name: spacing
fields.doc: Patch: cell size, m.

fields.name: lat
fields.doc: Patch: latitude of its centre, degrees; needs lon too.

fields.name: lon
fields.doc: Patch: longitude of its centre, degrees.

fields.name: near
fields.doc: Patch without lat/lon: centre it on the most such place.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Metres of terrain per scene unit.

fields.name: exaggeration
fields.doc: Vertical exaggeration.

fields.name: centre
fields.doc: Scene position of the patch's centre at sea level.

fields.name: min_river_width
fields.doc: Draw rivers at least this wide, m.

fields.name: map
fields.doc: Also write a shaded relief map image here.

fields.name: step
fields.doc: Length of a landscape evolution step, years.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Planet radius, m.

fields.name: land_bias
fields.doc: Positive makes more land, negative more sea.

fields.name: mountain_height
fields.doc: Height of the initial mountains above the plains, m.

fields.name: uplift_rate
fields.doc: Peak tectonic uplift, m per year.

fields.name: belt_frequency
fields.doc: Mountain belts per planet radius.

fields.name: strata_thickness
fields.doc: Thickness of one hard plus one soft bedrock layer, m.

fields.name: strata_contrast
fields.doc: Ratio of erodibility between softest and hardest bedrock.

fields.name: fold_amplitude
fields.doc: How far bedrock layers are folded up and down, m.

fields.name: cone_radius

fields.name: lava_fraction

fields.name: roughness

fields.name: migration

fields.name: friction

fields.name: omega

fields.name: gamma

fields.name: marine

fields.name: erosion

planet.label: Planet
planet.doc: The ground as a sphere whose top is at the origin, so that what is far away drops below the horizon.

fields.name: radius

mountains.label: Mountains
mountains.doc: A mountain range: a meshed heightfield of ridged noise around a massif, lying on the planet, with its own snow, rock and vegetation material (material and medium are ignored).

fields.doc: Middle of the square of terrain, [x, z].

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: How far the terrain reaches either side of the centre, m.

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Vertices along each side; build time grows with its square.

fields.doc: Where the massif's summit is, [x, z]; default the centre.

fields.name: peak_radius

fields.name: relief
fields.doc: Height of the ridged relief, m.

fields.name: feature_size
fields.doc: Size of the largest ridges, m.

fields.name: plains
fields.doc: Rolling relief of the plains around, m.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Height of its foot above the planet's surface, m; below zero for an island in a sea.

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: "flat" for flat ground; anything else follows the planet's curve.

fields.name: earth_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet the ground follows, m (unless flat).

fields.name: snowline
fields.doc: Height above which snow lies on gentle slopes, m.

fields.name: treeline
fields.doc: Height above which only rock shows, m.

fields.name: snow
fields.doc: Colour of snow.

fields.name: rock
fields.doc: Colour of bare rock.

fields.name: forest

fields.name: grass

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the terrain's noise.

ocean.label: Ocean
ocean.doc: An endless sea of Tessendorf waves at y = 0; a tiled mesh, or with "curved" the planet's surface displaced near the camera. A material or medium given replaces the ocean's own.

fields.name: wind

fields.name: time
fields.doc: Time of the wave animation, s; default 0 when curved.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Random realisation of the waves.

fields.name: amplitude
fields.doc: Phillips spectrum constant A (wave height squared); default 1/16384 flat, or when curved set from "resolved".

fields.name: resolution
fields.doc: Flat only: size of the repeating wave patch, m.

fields.name: fourier_size
fields.doc: Flat only: Fourier grid size, a power of two from 16 to 2048; build time and memory grow with its square.

fields.name: gravity
fields.doc: Flat only: gravitational acceleration, m/s^2.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Flat, not physical: colour of the deep water.

fields.name: physical
fields.doc: Flat only: use the physically lit water material (sun glitter, Fresnel sky reflection), as curved oceans always do.

fields.name: water
fields.doc: Physical or curved: albedo of the water body.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Physical or curved: mean square slope of unresolved ripples; default Cox and Munk's for the wind less the waves' own.

fields.name: debug
fields.doc: Flat only: shade by surface normal.

fields.name: curved
fields.doc: Make the ocean the planet's surface, physically lit, with waves displaced near the camera.

fields.name: resolved
fields.doc: Curved only: fraction of Cox and Munk's mean square slope carried by the displaced waves (ignored with "amplitude").

fields.name: earth_radius
fields.doc: Curved only: radius of the planet, m.

fields.name: detail_center
fields.doc: Curved only: [x, z] around which waves are displaced geometry (put it under the camera).

fields.name: detail_distance
fields.doc: Curved only: distance from detail_center over which waves are displaced, m.

skysphere.label: Sky
skysphere.doc: The sky all around the scene: Rayleigh and Mie scattering in a planet's atmosphere, with the sun's disc; its own material, so material and medium are ignored.

fields.name: preset
fields.doc: Atmosphere whose scattering values are the defaults below; an unknown name means earth.

fields.name: sun_direction
fields.doc: Direction towards the sun (normalised); a scene "sun" follows it.

fields.name: brightness
fields.doc: Multiplier on the sky's radiance.

fields.name: rayleigh_r
fields.doc: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for red, per metre at sea level (from the preset; earth shown).

fields.name: rayleigh_g
fields.doc: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for green, per metre (from the preset).

fields.name: rayleigh_b
fields.doc: Rayleigh scattering coefficient for blue, per metre (from the preset).

fields.name: mie_coefficient
fields.doc: Mie (haze) scattering coefficient, per metre at sea level (preset: earth 21e-6, sunset 25e-6, hazy 45e-6).

fields.name: mie_anisotropy
fields.doc: Mie phase anisotropy g (preset: earth 0.76, sunset 0.85, hazy 0.9).

fields.name: rayleigh_thickness
fields.doc: Scale height of the air, m (from the preset).

fields.name: mie_thickness
fields.doc: Scale height of the haze, m (from the preset).

fields.name: earth_location
fields.doc: Centre of the planet; the default puts its surface at the origin.

fields.name: earth_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet, m.

fields.name: atmosphere_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the top of the atmosphere, m.

fields.name: ozone
fields.doc: Absorption by the ozone layer; false turns it off.

fields.name: multiple_scattering
fields.doc: Add light scattered more than once in the atmosphere.

fields.name: ground_albedo
fields.doc: Reflectance of the planet's ground, as it lights the air (multiple scattering).

fields.name: crepuscular_rays
fields.doc: Let clouds and terrain shadow the air, making sunbeams (slower).

fields.name: aerial_perspective
fields.doc: Attenuate and haze distant objects by this atmosphere; false turns it off.

fields.name: lut
fields.doc: Look the sky up in a precomputed table; false integrates every ray exactly.

nubis_clouds.label: Nubis clouds
nubis_clouds.doc: A layer of procedural clouds from stratus to cumulus, after Horizon Zero Dawn's Nubis.

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Height of the layer's bottom, m.

fields.name: top
fields.doc: Height of the layer's top, m; must be above base.

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: Half-width of the square the clouds fill, m (not used by global mapping).

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Centre [x, z] of that square.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Random seed.

fields.name: density
fields.doc: Extinction coefficient in the densest cloud, per metre.

fields.name: coverage
fields.doc: Fraction of the sky that is cloud.

fields.name: cloud_type
fields.doc: 0 stratus, 0.5 stratocumulus, 1 cumulus.

fields.name: weather_size
fields.doc: Size of cloud fields, m; default 2.5 x (top - base), or 400000 with global mapping.

fields.name: shape_size
fields.doc: Size of individual clouds, m; default 0.8 x (top - base).

fields.name: detail_size
fields.doc: Size of the eroded detail, m; default 0.15 x (top - base).

fields.name: erosion
fields.doc: How strongly detail erodes the edges.

fields.name: mapping
fields.doc: "regional" curves the layer over the planet beneath the origin, "flat" leaves it on a flat earth, "global" wraps it round the whole planet.

fields.name: curved
fields.doc: false is the same as "mapping": "flat".

fields.name: earth_radius
fields.doc: Radius of the planet the layer is curved over, m.

fields.name: map_size
fields.doc: Global mapping: texels along each cube face of the weather map.

fields.name: climate
fields.doc: Global mapping: bands of more and less cloud by latitude.

fields.name: pole
fields.doc: Global mapping: direction of the planet's pole, for the climate bands.

fields.name: albedo
fields.doc: Fraction of light scattered rather than absorbed at each collision.

fields.name: g
fields.doc: Henyey-Greenstein asymmetry of the phase function, between -1 and 1 exclusive; not allowed with droplet_diameter.

fields.name: droplet_diameter
fields.doc: Water droplet diameter in µm (5 to 50) for a Mie phase function in place of g; absent means Henyey-Greenstein.

fields.name: similarity_after
fields.doc: Use the similarity relations (isotropic, reduced extinction) from this many scatterings on; absent means never.

fields.name: oz
fields.doc: Wrenninge et al.'s Oz multiple-scattering octaves: true for the defaults, or an object.

fields.name: octaves
fields.doc: Number of octaves.

fields.name: a
fields.doc: Factor on each octave's extinction.

fields.name: b
fields.doc: Factor on each octave's scattering (keep a <= b).

fields.name: c
fields.doc: Factor on each octave's phase asymmetry.

fields.name: diffraction
fields.doc: Diffraction by the particles (coronae, iridescence): true for the defaults, or an object.

fields.name: fraction
fields.doc: Share of the scattering that is diffracted.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Mean particle radius in µm, where the cloud itself does not give one.

fields.name: spread
fields.doc: Relative spread of the particles' sizes.

fields.name: halos
fields.doc: Ice-crystal halos: true for a third plates (sun dogs) and two thirds random columns (22° and 46° halos), or an object.

fields.name: crystals
fields.doc: Crystal populations; by default a plate (fraction 1/3, aspect 0.15, tilt 0.5) and a random (fraction 2/3, aspect 1.5, tilt 0).

fields.name: habit
fields.doc: How the hexagonal prisms are oriented.

fields.name: fraction
fields.doc: Share of the light this population takes (relative to the others).

fields.name: aspect
fields.doc: Prism half-height over its radius, above 0; default 0.15 for plates, 1.5 otherwise.

fields.name: tilt
fields.doc: Standard deviation of the tilt from horizontal, degrees.

fields.name: rays
fields.doc: Rays traced through crystals per colour channel to build the table.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Seed for the traced rays.

fields.name: rainbow
fields.doc: Raindrops' primary and secondary bows in direct sunlight.

hogan_kew_cirrus.label: Cirrus (Hogan and Kew)
hogan_kew_cirrus.doc: A layer of cirrus, cirrostratus or cirrocumulus as ice falling in streaks from generating cells, after Hogan and Kew.

fields.name: genus
fields.doc: Preset that sets the other defaults (those given here are cirrus's).

fields.name: base
fields.doc: Height of the layer's bottom, m.

fields.name: top
fields.doc: Height of the layer's top, m; must be above base.

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: Half-width of the square the layer fills, m.

fields.name: center

fields.name: fade
fields.doc: Fraction of extent over which the layer fades out at its edges.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Random seed.

fields.name: coverage
fields.doc: Fraction of the generating level that is cloud (cirrostratus 0.9, cirrocumulus 0.5).

fields.name: cell_size
fields.doc: Size of the largest generating cells, m (cirrostratus 6000, cirrocumulus 400).

fields.name: spectral_slope
fields.doc: Slope of the cells' spectrum: 5/3 for turbulence, steeper is smoother (cirrostratus 2.5).

fields.name: anisotropy
fields.doc: How many times longer the cells are along the wind than across (cirrocumulus 1).

fields.name: wind_direction

fields.name: density
fields.doc: Extinction coefficient in the thickest ice, per metre (cirrostratus 0.0002, cirrocumulus 0.0015).

fields.name: generating_depth

fields.name: fall_depth

fields.name: sublimation

fields.name: shear

fields.name: generating_wind

fields.name: fall_speed

fields.name: fall_speed_spread

fields.name: veer

fields.name: edge
fields.doc: Width of the cells' soft edge, in standard deviations of the field.

fields.name: flow_size

fields.name: flow

fields.name: fibre_width

fields.name: fibres

fields.name: turbulence_size

fields.name: turbulence

fields.name: particle_growth

fields.name: young_size

fields.name: time

fields.name: evolution_period

fields.doc: Species whose parameter table the tree starts from.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses this individual tree.

fields.name: location
fields.doc: Where the trunk meets the ground.

fields.name: bark
fields.doc: Material (or, failing that, medium) name for the bark; default a grey-brown lambertian.

fields.name: dead_bark
fields.doc: Material or medium name for dead branches' bark; default as "bark".

fields.name: leaves
fields.doc: A material or medium name, or a non-empty list of names dealt to the leaves at random; default a green lambertian. Leaf materials take autumn colours.

fields.name: params
fields.doc: Overrides of the species' parameters. Defaults shown are quaking-aspen's; each species has its own table, and keys absent from it fall back to the generic values.

fields.name: shape
fields.doc: Crown envelope: 0 conical, 1 spherical, 2 hemispherical, 3 cylindrical, 4 tapered cylindrical, 5 flame, 6 inverse conical, 7 tend flame.

fields.name: base_size
fields.doc: Fraction of the trunk, from the ground, without branches.

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Height of the tree, scene units.

fields.name: scale_v
fields.doc: Variation of the height.

fields.name: levels
fields.doc: Levels of stems including the trunk, 1 to 4.

fields.name: ratio
fields.doc: Trunk radius over trunk length.

fields.name: ratio_power
fields.doc: How quickly radii fall from one level to the next.

fields.name: lobes
fields.doc: Number of lobes around the trunk.

fields.name: lobe_depth
fields.doc: Depth of the trunk's lobes.

fields.name: flare
fields.doc: Widening of the trunk's base.

fields.name: trunk_scale
fields.doc: Scale of the trunk's radius.

fields.name: trunk_scale_v
fields.doc: Variation of trunk_scale.

fields.name: base_splits
fields.doc: Clones the trunk splits into at its base.

fields.name: leaves
fields.doc: Leaves per stem of the last level.

fields.name: leaf_scale
fields.doc: Leaf length, scene units.

fields.name: leaf_scale_x
fields.doc: Leaf width as a fraction of its length.

fields.name: leaf_quality
fields.doc: Multiplies the number of leaves, shrinking them to keep their total area.

fields.name: leaf_scale_v
fields.doc: Variation of each leaf's size, as a fraction.

fields.name: leaf_bend
fields.doc: How far leaves turn to face the sky, 0 to 1.

fields.name: leaf_shape
fields.doc: A flat pointed oval, or a tuft of five needles.

fields.name: attraction_up
fields.doc: Tendency of stems of level 2 and above to turn upwards (negative: droop).

fields.name: wander
fields.doc: How far stems meander, as a fraction of their length.

fields.name: roughness
fields.doc: Irregularity of stems' cross-sections, as a fraction of their radius.

fields.name: lean
fields.doc: Lean of the whole tree from the vertical, degrees.

fields.name: lean_v
fields.doc: Variation of the lean, degrees.

fields.name: branch_loss
fields.doc: Fraction of branches lost.

fields.name: autumn
fields.doc: How far through autumn: 0 all green, 1 every leaf turned and fallen.

fields.name: autumn_v
fields.doc: Spread of the times leaves start to turn, 0 to 0.95 of the season.

fields.name: leaf_fall
fields.doc: Fraction of dead leaves that fall.

fields.name: dead_branches
fields.doc: Fraction of branches that are dead, more of them low in the crown.

fields.name: dead_leaves
fields.doc: Fraction of a dead branch's leaves still hanging on it.

fields.name: stems
fields.doc: Per-level stem parameters, trunk first, merged into the species' by position; the level after the last stems' gives the leaves' angles.

fields.name: down_angle
fields.doc: Angle between a child stem and its parent, degrees.

fields.name: down_angle_v
fields.doc: Its variation; negative makes it vary along the parent, from down_angle + v at the base to down_angle - v at the tip.

fields.name: rotate
fields.doc: Angle about the parent between one child and the next, degrees; negative alternates sides in a flat spray.

fields.name: rotate_v
fields.doc: Variation of rotate, degrees.

fields.name: branches
fields.doc: Maximum child stems of this level on each parent.

fields.name: length
fields.doc: Length relative to the parent (the trunk's, to the tree's scale).

fields.name: length_v
fields.doc: Variation of length.

fields.name: taper
fields.doc: 0 to 1 cylinder to cone, 1 to 2 towards a rounded tip, 2 to 3 periodic like beads.

fields.name: seg_splits
fields.doc: Clones each segment splits into, on average.

fields.name: split_angle
fields.doc: Angle of a split, degrees.

fields.name: split_angle_v
fields.doc: Variation of split_angle, degrees.

fields.name: curve_res
fields.doc: Number of segments.

fields.name: curve
fields.doc: Total curvature of the stem, degrees (of its first half if curve_back is not 0).

fields.name: curve_back
fields.doc: Curvature of the second half, for S-shaped stems, degrees.

fields.name: curve_v
fields.doc: Variation of the curvature, degrees.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Approximate radius.

fields.doc: Geodesic subdivisions of its mesh; each step quadruples the triangles.

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: Chooses the shape (and the default material's pattern).

pebbles.doc: Pebbles scattered over a disc or rectangle of ground; by default a mix of stone materials, or one given material or medium, or a mix of named "materials".

fields.name: center
fields.doc: Middle of the patch, on the ground.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: Radius of the disc they cover (unless "extent" is given).

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: Cover a rectangle [x, z] across instead of a disc.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: Number of pebbles.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Smallest and largest pebble size.

fields.name: packing

fields.name: slope
fields.doc: Rise of the ground per unit x and per unit z.

fields.name: materials

fields.name: wetness
fields.doc: Wetness of the default stone mix, 0 to 1.

fields.name: detail
fields.doc: Geodesic subdivisions of each pebble's mesh.

fields.name: seed

fields.name: center

fields.name: size

fields.name: height

fields.name: feature_size

fields.name: strata

fields.name: strata_strength

fields.name: falloff

fields.name: resolution

fields.name: seed
